message.reasoning_content:
We need to output JSON with "task": the task A took in completed round. According to assigned joint allocation {"A":"T2","B":"T3"}. So A took T2. Note: handoff description of completed allocation and convention, including own and colleague's task. Must be at most 2000 characters. Return only JSON.

Thus produce something like:

{
  "task":"T2",
  "note":"In the previous round the allocation was A -> T2, B -> T3. All tasks were unclaimed at the start. After A and B chose, C and D selected T1 and T4 respectively, achieving 4 distinct tasks with total cost 23. The convention is that each round starts fresh with all tasks unclaimed and agents choose simultaneously, aiming to maximize distinct tasks then minimize total cost. Please continue with this convention in the next round."
}

Make sure note is within 2000 chars. That's fine.
